title: Iminodiacetic acid stabilized 3d-4f clusters: Synthesis, structure, and magnetism
claim: Encapsulating Gd52Ni56 in a silica shell by a microemulsion route increases the measured magnetocaloric effect and improves processability while keeping the cluster core intact.
explanation: A core-shell Gd52Ni56@SiO2 nanoparticle was made to probe magnetic coupling. Table 3 lists −ΔSm of 44.6 J kg−1 K−1 at 2.0 K and 7.0 T for the silica composite versus 40.5 J kg−1 K−1 at 2.0 K and 7.0 T for unencapsulated Gd52Ni56. Fig. 8 compares the temperature-dependent −ΔSm plots.
scope: Microemulsion silica encapsulation of the IDA Gd52Ni56 cluster.
conditions: Microemulsion synthesis of monodisperse silica-coated nanoparticles; MCE comparison at low temperature and up to 7 T.
caveats: The improvement is reported for this encapsulation example; the review does not generalize a quantitative enhancement factor.
